Sam (SRE): FYI I pulled the last 6 months of incidents and there are a few repeating themes we should action before next quarter. quick read + owners?
Nina (Eng): thanks. can you paste the top causes here?
Sam (SRE): sure — top 4 by frequency: infra config drift, model OOMs on long sequences, flaky 3rd-party auth, and rollout race conditions. rough numbers below.
Sam (SRE): ```
Period: 2025-10 -> 2026-03
1) infra config drift - 18 incidents (32%)
2) model OOMs - 12 incidents (21%)
3) 3p auth failures - 9 incidents (16%)
4) rollout races - 8 incidents (14%)
others - 9 incidents (17%)
```
Jordan (Product): hmm model OOMs showing up a lot in chat endpoints w/ long context. can we get a quick mitigation (hard cap) then follow up with optimizations?
Lee (Infra): +1 to hard cap. also infra config drift sounds like policy/provisioning gaps. propose a small RFC to lock critical flags and add drift alerts.
Maria (Oncall): I can add alert rules for config drift signals this week, but need an owner for follow-through.
Nina (Eng): I can own the short-term model OOM mitigation (quota + sequence cap) and a backlog item for batching/kv-cache tweaks. target: 2-week mitigation, 8-week optimization.
Sam (SRE): cool. proposed action items:
- AI-101: Config drift detection + auto-alert (owner: Maria) ETA: 2026-03-30
- AI-102: RFC to lock critical infra flags + deploy gating (owner: Lee) ETA: 2026-04-15
- AI-103: Short-term model seq cap + quota (owner: Nina) ETA: 2026-03-24
- AI-104: Model inference batching & cache improvements (owner: Nina) ETA: 2026-05-15
- AI-105: Improve 3rd-party auth retries & circuit breaker (owner: Jordan) ETA: 2026-04-01
- AI-106: Canary rollout checklist + automated rollback (owner: Lee) ETA: 2026-04-08
Jordan (Product): assign AI-105 to me. I'll coordinate with Security for auth token rotations and add tests.
Lee (Infra): I'll take AI-102 and AI-106. for AI-106 we should add a post-deploy health check that validates latency and error-rate thresholds.
Maria (Oncall): taking AI-101. I'll create alert runbook and tag oncall rotation.
Nina (Eng): taking AI-103 and AI-104. can we get priority for a dedicated infra slot for benchmarking? cc @Lee.
Lee (Infra): yes, will reserve a half-day infra slot each sprint for benchmarking work.
Sam (SRE): thanks all. one ask: please update the thread when you create the ticket or PR (link it here). I'll compile a one-page summary for the exec ops sync next Tue.
Jordan (Product): will do. pinging @Sam once AI-105 PR is up. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up items have been recorded to the incidents board (refs: AI-101,AI-102,AI-103,AI-104,AI-105,AI-106).
Sam (SRE): quick follow-up question — are there any recurring customer-facing incidents we should prioritize (SLA/comms)?
Jordan (Product): customer-facing mostly tied to 3p auth and rollouts causing partial outages. I'll escalate any high-impact ones to support and loop in comms.
Maria (Oncall): noted. I'll add a severity tag to AI-101 if the next alert shows customer impact.
Nina (Eng): timeline check: I'll aim to have the short-term cap PR by 2026-03-22 EOD, but may need a quick review from Lee.
Lee (Infra): can review on 2026-03-23 morning.
Sam (SRE): perfect. let's re-check progress in 1 week in this thread. thanks everyone. :heart:
Jordan (Product): thanks — will post PR links and any customer notes here.
Maria (Oncall): added initial alert rule and a stub runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/drift (will update after AI-101 complete)
Nina (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842 (seq cap) - requesting review from @Lee
Lee (Infra): reviewed and left comments. will approve after minor tweak.
Sam (SRE): great, thread will serve as canonical follow-up. reopening if anything slips.
Nina (Eng): merging PR tonight.
incident-bot: AI-103 status changed: in review -> merged
Sam (SRE): updated tracking doc with owners and ETAs: https://docs.redwood/incident-patterns/2026-03-synthesis
Jordan (Product): closing loop on comms for the two customer incidents, sent update to support and legal.
Maria (Oncall): AI-101 alert firing test succeeded in staging.
Sam (SRE): thanks. we'll run a month check to see if counts fall — next check: 2026-04-20.
Lee (Infra): adding a note: for long-term we should evaluate model quantization profiles to reduce memory pressure. adding to roadmap.
Nina (Eng): noted. adding to AI-104 scope.
Sam (SRE): end of thread for now — please keep this thread updated with ticket/PR links.
